prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: honestly you guys have the best mobile app for airlines hands down! Your developers need a raise!
Delta: Thanks for the techie compliment; we want flying Delta to be fun and comfortable!  ✈  *TJP

Customer: Is the mobile app down. I have been trying to log on for an hour
Delta: Hi, Lee. We don't show any reported issues. This seems to be a reoccurring issue for you. For any issues, please call 1-888-750-3284. *TMA

Customer: Rumors were true.  auto checked me in for my flight tomorrow via the mobile app. One less step. #EaseOfDoingBusiness
Delta: Hey Carl, happy we were able to accommodate you accordingly. 😄 *AJY

Customer: I have just booked my Mom on a flight from JNB-ORD next year using mobile app, no option to book “meet & assist” I need to book this for her please. May I send flight details via DM please? The local offices here are useless.
Delta: Please DM the ticket number. I will take a look.  *AMR

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: baggage):
"""Hey guys, made a trip last month and I checked in through the mobile app. Didn't receive a ticket for the baggage and need for travel expenses. Can you help?"""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: Please DM us your booking reference and a brief description of the issue so we can look into your baggage receipt and travel expenses.
